reviewer: writer33 peer reviewer; own batch33 excluded

scope.statement: This is a40-body/20-source sample review, not certification of all400articles, every cited source claim, or a vehicle repair procedure.

selectionMethod: Judgmental sample across oxygen/temperature/EGR/turbo/EVAP/ignition, diesel injection/glow/SCR/transmission/ECU, Jaguar throttle/fuel/ignition/transmission and hybrid brake/motor/isolation/precharge/battery/charger/network systems. Included available needs-review cases; batches32and34 had no needs-review labels before this review. P1791 replaced P1758 in the five-source batch34 subset after its explicit identity conflict was observed; P1758 remained a body-only sample.

bodyReads.observation: Opposed-bank lambda interpretation and CEUC-only thresholds are explicit.
Already needs-review; sensor-name ambiguity and electrical-versus-temperature distinction retained.
Body distinguishes diesel vacuum and gasoline applications and avoids automatic turbo replacement.
Already needs-review; inconsistent G66/G62 source identifier is explicitly retained.
Body distinguishes milliamperes from airflow and fault threshold from operating current.
No invented numeric calibration for the speed/fueling/target-airflow function.
Harness example bounded to stated Jetta application; no live-probing directions.
Preserves original amperes despite the high-voltage title rather than silently changing units.
Already needs-review; generic/VAG terminology difference and conditional oxygen-sensor branch disclosed.
Body preserves gearbox subtype, other-fault conditions and professional-test boundary.
Body ties the correlation comparison to an extended soak, not a running thermal limit.
One unsupported hot-start phrase corrected; other quoted criteria matched the source.
Absolute pressure, engine-off/cranking state and electrical-versus-functional distinction matched.
Body separates driver-side short, open circuit and injector response; warns against energized probing.
Body explicitly narrows the implementation to3.2L and does not infer multiple failed injectors or8-cylinder applicability.
Body retains A/D-count units, bank-level scope and long heating interval.
Inductive current signature is kept separate from resistance and gear-ratio tests.
Body describes estimated DEF range without guaranteeing remaining driving distance.
Internal5V rail is explicitly separated from battery/alternator voltage.
Body distinguishes missing verification data from general module loss and avoids direct battery power to glow plugs.
Heater-related signal coupling, volts and repeated-event count are preserved.
Voltage window is limited to closed-position learning, not all flap positions.
Body treats12percent as a source monitor criterion, not an adjustment setting.
Body gives scoped alternative causes and professional fuel-system boundaries.
V12 and AJ16 rows are separated with different monitor states and trip counts.
Body distinguishes shutdown and running injector-monitor windows and avoids fuel-rail disassembly instructions.
Electrical and mechanical causes remain distinct; no guard bypass procedure.
Body scopes internal controller timing to ZF4HP24 and avoids importing fallback gear from another section.
Body describes aggregate current and a scoped fallback without direct regulator-power instructions.
Primary TPS source and canonical ignition-supply definition conflict confirmed; review classification corrected without altering diagnosis.
Already needs-review; rear-left versus master-cylinder source inconsistency retained, no self-test stimulation instructions.
Body avoids locating a leak or asserting safe driving from monitored hydraulic inconsistency.
Body confines numeric claims to supported slip branch and expressly omits inconsistent energy branch.
Current, squared-current units and phase-angle window matched; no live motor-phase testing instructions.
Sum-versus-pack-voltage calculation, switch state and sample count matched.
Body distinguishes requested precharge sequence from arbitrary low bus voltage and forbids bypassing contactors.
Calculated sense-line resistance is distinguished from cell-capacity diagnosis; no manual balancing instructions.
Body distinguishes circuit-high from hot temperature and preserves HV-service boundary.
Body keeps both voltage reports and charging readiness in view; no external HV-probing recipe.
UART daisy-chain and controller-managed recovery matched; no instruction to bridge pack wiring.

findings.metadataPattern: Batch34 author notes and article disclosures contained explicit canonical-definition limitations while metadata said checked. Nine records now say needs-review; these changes classify disclosed uncertainty and do not resolve it.
sourceFidelityLimitations: P2027 retains a source current criterion under a high-voltage title; no independent workshop validation of that unusual table entry was performed.
P1295 remains expressly limited to the source3.2L monitor and does not certify the broader legacy catalog shorthand.
P1189/P1195 disclose internal source ambiguity; only targeted excerpts were inspected and no new original-row check was performed.

limitations: Only the20listed article-source relationships were independently checked against original publisher material. Body-only observations do not verify all numeric claims.
Additional metadata corrections rely on existing disclosed conflicts plus author notes; only sampled P1791 received an independent original-row check.
PDF checks used paginated text extracted from the original downloaded PDFs, with section/physical-page context. No full-document visual audit or vehicle-specific workshop validation was performed.
No model applicability beyond explicit source sections was certified; no vehicles, repairs or diagnostic procedures were physically tested.
No shared source partitions, publication manifests, generated reports, commits or deployment settings were changed.
